displayName: Botox & Neurotoxin Consent + Pre/Post Care Bundle
description: Everything a nurse injector, NP, or med spa needs to document Botox and neurotoxin treatments professionally. Includes consent forms, pre-treatment screening, post-care instructions, and a treatment record tracker — all HIPAA-aware and fully editable in Canva.
targetBuyer: Nurse injectors, NPs, PAs, and med spa owners offering Botox, Dysport, Xeomin, or Daxxify

templates.name: Neurotoxin Consultation & Medical History Form
templates.description: Full pre-treatment consultation capturing medical history, medications, contraindications, and aesthetic goals

templates.name: Botox / Neurotoxin Informed Consent Form
templates.description: Comprehensive consent covering risks, benefits, alternatives, realistic outcomes, and longevity expectations

templates.name: Pre-Treatment Instructions — Neurotoxin
templates.description: Patient handout with 72-hour pre-treatment dos and don'ts to reduce bruising and optimize results

templates.name: Post-Treatment Aftercare Instructions — Neurotoxin
templates.description: Detailed post-injection care including activity restrictions, positioning, and when to expect results

templates.name: Neurotoxin Treatment Record & Dosing Log
templates.description: Per-visit documentation form with injection site diagram, units per area, lot number, and provider signature

templates.name: Before/After Photography Consent
templates.description: HIPAA-compliant photo consent with options for clinical use, marketing use, and social media use

deliveryNote: All templates open in Canva as your own editable copy. Add your clinic name, logo, provider credentials, and state-specific language. We recommend having your medical director review all consent forms before clinical use.
_autoMatchNote: Suggested URLs come from Canva list-designs edit URLs (temporary). Review before import.
